Tracing emits SwiftLog metadata without recording result values or error messages. Events describe start, retry, permit waiting/acquisition/cancelled waits, cancellation requests, and success or failure. A failure event leaves the original thrown error unchanged.

returns snapshots of explicitly traced work, including its elapsed time, permit wait state, and whether cancellation was requested. It does not enumerate every Swift task. Cancellation requests do not remove work from the snapshot: an operation stays active until it actually finishes, even if it ignores cancellation.
